title: The Protocol of the Rust Belt
author: Yara Nystrom
blurb: Freya Eriksen, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
